city_center.name: Downtown Yakima + the Yakima Valley farm belt (Tri-Cities to the southeast)
city_center.landmark: the Yakima Valley -- 'the Palm Springs of Washington' and the fruit-and-hops heart of the state; sagebrush shrub-steppe hills; the Columbia and Yakima Rivers; the Tri-Cities (Kennewick, Pasco, Richland) at the Columbia confluence
city_center.notes: The Yakima Valley is Washington's fruit and hops powerhouse -- the state grows the vast majority of US hops and leads the nation in apples. The Tri-Cities sit at the Columbia River confluence in wine and irrigated-farm country. sources: en.wikipedia.org Yakima Valley; Washington apple + hops production framing.

Fred Meyer, WinCo, and Yoke's are the regional grocers; the Tri-Cities anchor Columbia Valley wine country (source: chain regional footprint)
